lines.text: The Formula of Becoming. Begins July thirty-first.

lines.text: Malik Baptiste believes the right plan can keep the future from surprising him.

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: My family budget was balanced when I left. Now it isn't.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: Then it was a model with new information.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At McCall-Hart, every answer opens another choice.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then the storm turns uncertainty into something he can no longer keep off the page.

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: I keep looking at flood estimates. But I do not know how high the water got inside.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: You trust me with goals. Why do you not trust me with bad news?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Mathematics cannot promise certainty. It can teach us what honesty asks next.

lines.text: Where college life, friendship, and mathematics meet.
